caseNameFull: Butz, Secretary of Agriculture v. Hein and Burns, Commissioner, Department of Social Services of Iowa v. Hein

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. Iowa. Motion of appellee Hein for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 402 F. Supp. 398.
